objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Describe how ordinary French people faced hunger and heavy taxes under the Old Regime before the Revolution.

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Sequence the major events of the French Revolution, from the storming of the Bastille in 1789 to the rise and fall of Napoleon.

standards: C3 D2.His.1.K-2 — Create a chronological sequence of multiple events (history, grades K-2)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Generate possible reasons why the French people rose up against King Louis XVI and the aristocracy in 1789.

standards: C3 D2.His.14.K-2 — Generate possible reasons for an event or development in the past (history, grades K-2)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Explain how the ideals of liberty, equality, and fraternity shaped the goals and actions of French revolutionaries.

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Analyze the multiple causes of the French Revolution, including financial crisis, social inequality, and Enlightenment ideas.

standards: C3 D2.His.14.9-12 — Analyze multiple and complex causes and effects of events in the past (history, grades 9-12)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Evaluate how Napoleon Bonaparte both preserved and betrayed the ideals of the Revolution as he built an empire across Europe.

standards: C3 D2.His.3.9-12 — Use questions generated about individuals and groups to assess how the significance of their actions (history, grades 9-12)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Evaluate how the French Revolution was shaped by the unique circumstances of late-18th-century France and assess its lasting impact on modern nationalism and democracy.

standards: C3 D2.His.1.9-12 — Evaluate how historical events and developments were shaped by unique circumstances of time and plac (history, grades 9-12)
